collection.title: Ferrari F430 2005 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ferrari F430 2005 - 2010 requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 21" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
